statements.text: IWMT agrees with IIT that posterior cortices, the posterior hot zone and perhaps specific subnetworks of it, provide necessary and sufficient conditions for a consciousness-entailing generative model of self and world over the sensorium. The stream of experience itself may always be generated in hierarchies centered on posterior cortex.
